title: Sufi Movement Use Of Music In Sufism
definition: Sama (audition) is the practice of listening to music, poetry, and dance as a spiritual mechanism to induce 'Wajd' (ecstatic state) and facilitate the soul's communion with the Divine.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Art & Culture and Medieval History sections; focuses on the intersection of Islamic orthodoxy, regional syncretism, and the evolution of Hindustani classical music.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Sufi Movement Use Of Music In Sufism.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Sufi Silsilas (Chishti vs. Suhrawardi)
